body:
Founder real-time: 'earlier it seemed like it was going much faster 2-3 minutes per generations... ive been waitin for 15 mins.' Root cause: S429's real match timer changed run_evaluation_match's own default max_ticks to the full MATCH_TIME_LIMIT_TICKS (9000, ~2.5 real min) -- correct for an actual played match, but rl_train_packet.py's automatic per-generation eval (S424) calls this up to 3x every generation with no override, so weak early policies that never land a KO could each silently run the full 9000-tick timeout (~6+ min) -- up to ~18 min of pure eval overhead per generation on top of real training time. Fixed: the per-generation eval call now passes an explicit EVAL_MAX_TICKS=1800 (~30s), the original pre-S429 default this pipeline already used successfully -- a draw after this cap is a real, honest outcome for a fast comparison. 125/125 tests pass. BRAWLPIT commit a25664e.

⚓ ☃
title: S436: fixed real per-generation eval slowdown (up to ~18 min/gen overhead)
